dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curvature defined by a smooth spline from the dorsal ridge junction to the rounded apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a high pixel radius and obtuse interior angle.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-degree angular steepness relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Maximum base width exceeds maximum vertical height by a ratio of approximately 1.7:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a large radius forming a bulbous anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby beak with a low length-to-thickness ratio extending from the melon inflection.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle measured at the pixel coordinate where the melon slope meets the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform cyan-teal chromatic profile with synthetic digital highlights along the dorsal and lateral mid-lines.
